product.description: Extend the reach of your AC powered device using this AC power extension cord to energize equipment from a distant power outlet. This cable features a standard, grounded IEC 60320 C14 plug on one end and an IEC 60320 C13 receptacle on the other. IEC 60320 C14 to C13 power cords are commonly used between rack mounted equipment and the PDU in a data cabinet.
